Comments: Civil registration (birth and death notifications) is integrated with NPRS via e-birth and e-death notification platforms hosted at health facilities. NPRS is the main building block of the interoperability framework. Civil Registration and Identification Bill (pending) will further formalize this.

Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: The NPRS (National Population Registration System) is integrated with Nam-X as the core identity node. NIDA connects to at least 11 other systems. The Civil Registration and Identification Bill is pending to further formalize digital ID links. E-birth/death notifications feed into NPRS via National Data Exchange Service Bus.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Electronic Transactions Act 4 of 2019 provides framework for e-government and electronic communications. However, it is only partially enacted (as of 2025). Draft Data Protection Bill and Civil Registration and Identification Bill are still pending. No specific data sharing/interoperability law exists yet.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: Digital Government Strategic Roadmap for Namibia 2024-2026 exists with a two-year planning horizon. Cybernetica also delivered updated e-government roadmaps in 2021-2022 project. Roadmap includes milestones for digital identity and data sharing.

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: Digital Government Strategic Roadmap for Namibia 2024-2026 specifically addresses data sharing and interoperability (Pillar 3: Digital Government includes 'Increased government data sharing'). National Digital Strategy Plan 2025 also addresses interoperability. E-Government Strategic Action Plan was established earlier.

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: Nam-X (Namibia Governmental Interoperability Framework), based on Estonian UXP/X-Road, was launched in 2014 and is partially operational. Ongoing 2024 project by Cybernetica/ESTDEV focuses on scaling and developing two digital services. Civil registration, NPRS, and some government databases are connected. Full-scale inter-agency coverage remains incomplete.

Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Reports note significant urban-rural gap: Windhoek, Walvis Bay, Swakopmund have benefited from broadband while remote rural communities face low connectivity. NDP6 aims to increase internet access from 53% to 90% by 2030.
